On 2026-11-20 the user asked to "work on a1+ Unit 7 same all deal as before none stop all approved": the A1+ Unit 7 map (A1+ 7.Y follows A1 7.Y, one step each, fifteen lessons) approved up front, straight to Preview, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. Two new photos (Gemini 2.5 Flash): Sofia hits a tennis ball with a strong swing, and Luis sits on a tennis court laughing among the balls he missed. A1 7.13's woman singing and three singers, and the cast's A1+ photos of Diego painting, Ana swimming and Diego running show what they are good at. Revised on 2026-11-24: the review of A1+ Unit 7 reported that this lesson added a grammar step with little new vocabulary, and the user answered "Yes, add words". Two words are new: basketball (Luis makes a shot) and piano (Ana plays), on two new Gemini 2.5 Flash photos; they sit beside A1 7.13's tennis and singing.

lesson.title: 7.13 Sofia is good at tennis
lesson.unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
lesson.unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
lesson.goal: Say what people are good at with be + good at (Sofia is good at tennis. / Luis isn't good at tennis.), ask What are you good at?, and name two more: basketball and playing the piano.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.13 Sports and Music: A1 names sports and singing (Tennis is a sport. They sing.); A1+ 7.13 says who is good at them. The one new grammar relationship is be + good at + a sport or an -ing activity (Sofia is good at tennis. / They're good at singing.), with isn't/aren't for the opposite (A1+ 3.4) and the question What are you good at?. Two new photos show Sofia playing tennis well and Luis sitting on the court among missed balls; A1 7.13's singers and the cast's A1+ photos of painting, swimming and running come back. Two words are new and stay inside the same frame: basketball, a sport like tennis (Luis is good at basketball.), and piano, with playing the (Ana is good at playing the piano.).
lesson.prerequisite: A1 7.13 tennis and sing; A1 7.6 paint; A1+ 3.4 isn't/aren't; A1+ 7.6 like + -ing; A1+ 1.3 swim and run.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Join good at (GOOD-at) and stress the activity; say isn't good at with a clear t; stress BAS-ket-ball on the first part and pi-A-no on the second. Do not require native-like speed.
